title: Budget-Indexed Causal Law Field, Cross-Budget State Correspondence, Descriptor Intervention Feasibility, Generator Schema Evolution & Architecture–Budget Product-Space Transport

state_correspondence.capacity: K8 label permutation only; no learned continuous map; no outcome optimization
state_correspondence.objective: maximize exact cell overlap with the anchor K8 partition over the full 384-world census; lexicographic tie-break
state_correspondence.composition: all cross-budget maps factor through the 80k anchor, guaranteeing cycle consistency by construction
state_correspondence.selection_after_alignment: within each family×side×anchor-K8 state choose two of three cells by exhaustive outcome-blind support optimization across all mapped budgets
state_correspondence.support_gate: every selected family×side×budget×mapped-K8 state must have at least one cell before selective outcomes open

claim_ceiling: A finite permutation correspondence is deliberately low-capacity and may miss nonlinear relations; failure therefore localizes to this frozen correspondence family, not all possible maps.
Budget-index necessity over node controls does not imply the same field under time controls or different hardware.
Descriptor feasibility is a source-architecture audit, not a causal estimate of descriptor effects.
No selective outcome may change the correspondence family, anchor budget, support gate, engine set, intervention algebra, or budgets.

adjudication_support.rule: for each budget × mapped-K8 state × relation square, deterministically sort candidate SHA within each of the four material vertices and truncate all four vertices to the minimum pre-intervention support
adjudication_support.authority: uses only frozen state labels and candidate identity; no selective outcome enters support equalization
